home.title: What do you need help with?
home.intro: Pick one or more. We'll show companies that offer them, with prices and what's included.
home.noSignup: No sign-up needed. We only ask for contact details if you request a quote.

questions.title: A few details to match prices
questions.location: Where is your business, or where will it be?
questions.visas: How many visas do you need?
questions.timing: When do you need it done?

results.title: Companies for you
results.explainer: Verified means our team checked the company's licence on the official portal. Unverified means we haven't checked yet. Neither says anything about service quality.
results.reviews: ({count, plural, =1 {1 verified review} other {# verified reviews}})
results.stale: Price not updated for over 60 days. Ask the company to confirm.
results.renewalWarning: Renewal cost not stated. Ask before you commit.
results.pricesNote: Prices are supplied by each company and confirmed in their written quote. Government fees are indicative.
results.empty: No companies match these answers yet. Try another location or fewer services.

profile.verifiedBody: Licence checked on the official portal: {date}. The badge expires with the licence and is re-checked after that.
profile.verifiedNote: Verified confirms the licence only. It is not a guarantee of service quality.
profile.unverifiedBody: We haven't checked this company's licence yet. You can still request a quote, but check their licence yourself before paying anything.
profile.supplied: Supplied by the company, updated {date}. Confirmed in their written quote.
profile.reviewsNote: Reviews come only from customers who completed a service through the app.
profile.ctaNote: Free. Your details go only to this company, and only with your OK.

quote.title: Request a quote
quote.yourDetails: Your name and one way to reach you
quote.name: Your name
quote.consent: I agree to share these details with {company} only, so they can send me a quote. I can withdraw this at any time.
quote.privacy: Privacy notice: link to be added before launch.
quote.neverAsk: We never ask for your passport, Emirates ID or bank details here.
quote.tickFirst: Tick the box above to send.

errors.name: Please enter your name (2 to 100 characters).
errors.contact: Please enter one phone number or one email address.
errors.consent: Please tick the box to agree before sending.
errors.rate: Too many requests from this connection. Please try again later.
errors.general: Something went wrong. Nothing was sent. Please try again.

quote.sentBody: {company} will contact you with a written quote. Only this company received your details.
quote.beforePayBody: Check that the quote lists government fees, company fees, visas and renewal costs. Avoid paying the full amount upfront.
quote.unavailable: This package is no longer available.

auth.signInIntro: For partner companies and Advisr staff. Accounts are created by an admin.
auth.codeIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code.
auth.recoveryIntro: Enter one of your saved recovery codes. Each code works once.

errors.badLogin: The email or password is not correct.
errors.badCode: That code is not correct, or sign-in is paused for a few minutes after repeated mistakes.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

auth.portalSoon: You are signed in. Your screens are being added in the next releases.
auth.enrolIntro: Every account needs an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password). Enter your password to start.
auth.scanIntro: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
auth.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
auth.typeSecret: Type this key into your authenticator app instead:
auth.codesIntro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you in once. They are shown only now. Store them somewhere safe and private.
